info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Reference Data Directory API
info.description: The Party Reference Data Directory API facilitates the management and updating of essential party reference data within a banking context. This API allows organizations to synchronize and enrich their customer information, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Typical consumers include financial institutions and customer relationship management systems seeking to enhance their customer data repositories. Operations may involve updating existing party records or integrating new information to maintain a robust and reliable database of customer entities.
